title: US stalker ordered to pay $18.6 million after stealing woman's Verizon records with fake warrant
summary_full: In a landmark ruling, a federal judge in North Carolina has ordered convicted stalker Robert Michael Glauner to pay $18.632 million to a victim for the emotional trauma inflicted upon her. This judgment, which includes punitive damages, stems from Glauner's harassment after he unlawfully procured her private information with a forged search warrant. He was apprehended while attempting to confront her and remains incarcerated.
